caption: Protein stays the hero; calories, carbs and fat sit under it. Start opens the workout.
Other lift-card states: no program (Start workout, Repeat last, optional Programs link) and workout in progress. A program is never required.
Plans hub.
Program preview. Customize makes "your version".
Your version: drag to reorder days, rename, add, reset.
Edit a day. Tap an exercise for sets, reps, rest, progression, superset. Remove shows Undo.
Change days per week: always a preview first.
Reschedule without editing the program.
Quick workout: no program needed. Pick an exercise, repeat a recent workout, or search.
Exercises added on the fly. On Finish, "Save as workout" is offered but never required.
Overview: done, up next, later.
Exercise screen (A2): diagram, name, last time, goal, sets, cue. Brass = primary muscle, lighter = secondary. Figure shown is a placeholder for the existing muscle map.
Finished exercise with a PR badge and the estimated max change.
Superset: two exercises stacked, one rest timer. Back exercises use the back view.
+ sheet. Set is highlighted as the last-used tile.
Pick the exercise: today's exercises first, then recents. Typing searches the whole catalog.
Log one set: big steppers prefilled from the previous set, today's sets listed below, rest timer pinned. Same components as the full exercise screen.
Pro: headline, findings, next-session targets.
Free: basic summary and one quiet upsell row. (On iPhone this opens the in-app purchase paywall.)
Library home: search, muscle and equipment filters, recents, stalled lifts, A–Z.
Exercise page, History tab.
Form tab.
Swaps tab: same primary muscle, filtered by equipment.
Picker: filters, aliases in search (Cable Crossover finds Cable Fly), last numbers inline.
Back exercises show the back view. Timed and cardio exercises use different inputs.
